1  While serving as Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, Chief of Staff  
of the Army, Chief of Naval Operations, Chief of Staff of the Air Force,  
or Commandant of the Marine Corps, basic pay for this grade is $3,976.20*  
regardless of cumulative years of service computed under section 205 of  
this title.
2  Does not apply to commissioned officers who have been credited with 
over 4 years’ active service as enlisted members.
*The rate of basic pay for military personnel at these rates is limited by  
sectipn 5308 of title 5, United States Code, as added by the Federal Pay  
Comparability Act of 1970, to the rate for level V  of the Executive Schedule 
($36,000 per annum, or $3,000 per month as of the effective date of this  
adjustment).
FEDERAL REGISTER, VOL. 38, N O. 193— FRIDAY, OCTOBER 5, 1973
